attributes: What stays the same or changes

cells.quote: The enthalpy, internal energy, and volume are all changed, but the pressure remains the same.
Then, for a constant pressure process the enthalpy equation becomes:
We have added a subscript “p” to the specific heat capacity to remind us that this value only applies to a constant pressure process.
cells.value: subscript “p” to the specific heat capacity

cells.quote: we have a constant volume process with our gas that produces exactly the same temperature change
For a constant volume process, the work is equal to zero.
We have added a subscript “v” to the specific heat capacity to remind us that this value only applies to a constant volume process.
cells.value: subscript “v” to the specific heat capacity
